Understand the criteria before you apply.

Get the current written requirements for the specific home before submitting an application.

Confirm the basics

Ask about availability, rent, deposits, application fees, occupancy terms, and the designated application provider. Review the written criteria before paying or sending documents.

Use a secure application channel

Submit sensitive documents only through the authorized application process. This website does not collect identity documents, Social Security numbers, or application payments.

Ask about property-specific terms

Clarify pets, utilities, parking, lease length, and any other terms important to your household. Your application and lease documents should reflect the current requirements.
